blocks.text: Propositional logic is a basic form of logic used in computer science. It deals with statements that can be true or false. These statements are called propositions (as shown in Figure 2.3)

blocks.alt: Four statements, each with an arrow to its truth value: 2 + 3 = 5 is True, The sky is blue is True, 1 > 3 is False, Today is Sunday is False.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Propositional Logic Statements (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 2.3).

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Propositional logic is the simplest type of logic, but it forms the base of all computer reasoning!
